requirements: POSIX Sphinx Makefile exposes html, latex, latexpdf, linkcheck, release, and clean targets
Windows make.bat exposes matching html, latex, latexpdf, linkcheck, release, and clean commands
LaTeX document output is explicitly named xstar-tools.tex
LaTeX converts the four architecture SVG diagrams to EPS3 while HTML keeps SVG
Generated Sphinx EPS references are normalized from {name}.eps spelling to name.eps spelling
latexpdf explicitly runs two latex passes followed by dvips and ps2pdf
latexpdf does not require Sphinx make-mode, latexmk, pdflatex, or epstopdf
PDF generation remains optional and is not added to the normal release target
Read the Docs installs the pinned documentation dependency set
science-critical source hashes and public ABIs remain frozen
scope: documentation build targets, EPS reference normalization, DVI/PostScript/PDF pipeline, Read the Docs dependencies, and package-version metadata only
